item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 07/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, temperatures will remain relatively low over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. With the cloud band covering the region thinning out gradually and the monsoon replaced by an easterly airstream, it will be brighter and temperatures will rise progressively in the following couple of days. A maritime airstream will bring warm and humid weather to the coastal areas midweek next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of next week. Temperatures will drop again and there will be a few showers over the region.
